correctness.rationale: Every valid multipath contains at most one arc per one of four global arc types; the only possible cycles under the degree constraints are 2-cycles at a leaf and 4-cycles between two leaves. The admissibility criterion is exhaustive. The symmetry group preserving two allowed local pairings has order eight and is D8. The augmented Lefschetz sign equals (-1) per vertex orbit of a fixed face. A fixed face meets at most four leaf cycles total weight<=4; all 12 integer cycle-support templates suffice for all n. Direct independent digraph face enumeration and signed-fixed-face computation yielded (169,-11,-41,1,1) for n=6 and identity leaf permutation, matching all five asserted polynomials. The inspected exact coefficient script performs finite difference calculations on every 12 bounded-support template. Finite full n tests alone are not the proof; uniform support bound makes finite template exhaustion mathematically complete.
residual_risks: Alternating rational character only; does not separate homological degrees or determine integral torsion.
